verdict.rationale: Morph's documented offering is an API platform: chat models, Fast Apply, WarpGrep, Compact and Reflexes, consumed by external agents such as Claude Code or Codex, or through its MCP server. A built-in assistant is a plausible feature for a developer platform, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. Supplying tools to other agents is adjacent and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
